description: Pull-only FHIR R4 client for an external server that issues a static access token. Reads the bound patient's Observations, DiagnosticReports, MedicationStatements and Encounters into the ingest funnel with per-resource cursors and sealed credentials; unmapped codes land raw with the mapping gap recorded. Push and SMART-on-FHIR live in the FHIR Server connector.
author: Health Assistant Core

secrets.purpose: Static bearer/API-key token for the remote FHIR server, sealed in integration_credentials

en.title: FHIR Client (Keyed Pull)
en.summary: Pull-only FHIR R4 sync from a token-issuing external server.
